Sarah (sales): FYI customer FinTechX returned the CAIQ. They specifically called out ambiguity on KMS ownership, rotation evidence, and log retention for Dedicated vs Private. Need an authoritative answer + sample evidence by EOD Friday. Who owns what?
Ajay (solutions): For POC we usually state: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys; Dedicated = option for Redwood-managed or BYOK (contract + provisioning); Private = customer-managed KMS (BYOK). We should call this out in the CAIQ answers and include evidence mapping.
Omar (security): +1. We'll need a control mapping doc and a redacted evidence pack. I can produce the CAIQ JSON snippets and the rotation policy text. Who can pull a sample key rotation event for Dedicated?
Elaine (eng-infra): I can grab a redacted rotation event and a sample retention log. We don't have access to customer keys in Private, so we'll provide a template of the customer-side evidence and a playbook for redaction. Example rotation log line I can share:
```
2026-03-20T22:11:02Z key_rotation id=kr-abcde user=system status=success
```
Sarah (sales): Great. Customer also asked about access to plaintext model outputs and whether Redwood ever persists outputs in a retrievable way. Need a short statement for the CAIQ entry.
Ajay (solutions): We have that statement in docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/security/data-handling - I'll pull the paragraph and include it in the CAIQ response. For the POC plan propose: 1) return CAIQ answers with explicit ownership rows, 2) attach redacted rotation log and retention policy, 3) offer a short POC where we ingest their audit evidence into their vendor portal.
Omar (security): Also flag legal for BYOK - rotation/ownership terms and audit access if they require us to attest. I'll draft an addendum. SecBot: Reminder: add request id FINX-1234 to all deliverables and CAIQ filenames.
Elaine (eng-infra): I'll prepare the redacted rotation log + short playbook on what we can/can't attest for Private deployments. ETA tomorrow noon.
Sarah (sales): Thanks — Ajay can you draft the customer email and attach the CAIQ answers? I'll loop in legal after your draft.
Ajay (solutions): On it. Drafting now, will post for review in this thread shortly.
